_comment: PLACEHOLDER — Milestone 5 (anchor baking): replace the three diffs with real commits selected from the configured repo and reviewed with the user. Until then, scoring will run against synthetic exemplars and scores should be considered uncalibrated.

anchors.note: Trivial one-line change with no behavioral risk: a config value, constant, or a single boolean/return flip (with or without an explanatory comment). This class of change scores 2-3.
Feature work across a few files: a new endpoint with validation and a repository method, moderate domain understanding required.
Subtle concurrency fix: reorders lock acquisition and reworks retry state machine to eliminate a deadlock; small diff, high diagnostic effort.
